approved_payload.content: Komani News reports, quoting SAPS spokesperson Capt Yolisa Mgolodela, that Bholotwa police were called back to Mawethu Tavern at about 01:15 on Sunday 4 October after a group of men allegedly returned, some armed, stopping patrons from leaving and assaulting people who tried to. Police say officers were attacked with bottles and fired warning shots while the van driver tried to reverse away. One person was injured and another was declared dead at the scene. SAPS has not confirmed that the person who died was struck by a police bullet, and says the circumstances of the injury and death are under investigation. Residents told the paper the dead man was a young man shot during the confrontation; SAPS has not confirmed this. Police opened an inquest and cases of attempted murder and attack on police. The person who died was not named. One report only.

Another Bolotwa in Mbhashe (GeoNames) was not used: the report names Bholotwa police and comes from a Chris Hani paper. Municipality not stated by any source.
